mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 5.25% in a given month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, no significant negative returns occur after such rate spikes when inflation (CPIAUCSL) is flat or declining.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in UNRATE above 5.5% is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as higher labor market disengagement reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment intentions.
regime_hint: High unemployment or weak wage growth
failure_condition: In regimes with strong wage growth (e.g., low unemployment), UNRATE increases do not predict negative 20-day forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly GDPC1 (real private consumption) exceeds INDPRO by more than 8% in the same month, it signals robust demand growth that precedes a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is not statistically significantly positive after such a demand gap in contractionary or balanced phases.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive 2-month decline in INDPRO below 100 (index normalization) while HOUST remains above 1100 suggests supply-side weakness, predicting a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: No negative 5-day returns occur when INDPRO declines but HOUST does not fall, indicating demand compensation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in CPIAUCSL below 237 (annualized inflation below 2%) coincides with an always-on positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as markets price in lower real rate expectations.
failure_condition: Over 12 months, the 20-day forward return does not outperform a flat-rate benchmark when inflation remains elevated.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS falls by more than 10,000 in a month (indicating job losses), the S&P 500 shows a negative 20-day forward return as investor risk aversion rises.
failure_condition: No significant negative returns when PAYEMS declines but GDP growth (GDPC1) is robust.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in RSAFS (>400,000) and HOUST (>1100) above their prior month's levels predict a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as indicators of business and consumer demand strength converge.
failure_condition: No positive 60-day return when both indicators rise but GDP (GDPC1) remains flat.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for three consecutive months in a non-recession regime, it signals easing labor market constraints and supports a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return via optimism about growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 for 3 consecutive months and not in recession regime
failure_condition: No positive 20-day return when UNRATE declines but other labor indicators (PAYEMS) are rising sharply.
